The series has strong trend/seasonality and unstable ranking; a simple mean may be a useful robust baseline to compare against weighted combos.
Seasonal strength is very high, so trimming outliers may improve stability.
ranking is unstable and several models are in distinct correlation groups; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture changing strengths across the 13‑week horizon.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9665. Series context: trend strength 0.889 and seasonal strength 0.9992; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.037); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.442.
